title: 第2354章 独战强敌第2353章 守株待兔
content_zh:
在血刀神王四人离开之后。
手持命运神珠，通过神珠的力量，彻底隐匿着修为气息的冥夜无天，从黑暗中走了出来。
此刻，他的表情，格外的精彩。
“看来，远古生灵是将我当成了牧帆，又将牧帆，当成是我了，难怪……”
冥夜无天笑了笑。
忽然能理解，死在他手中的远古生灵，元诡神尊，为何会说出那种话了。
“我还得借助牧帆的时空宝塔修炼呢！可不能让他出事！”
说着，冥夜无天握着时刻催动着的命运神珠，锁定到了牧帆的位置，紧接着，飞速赶了过去。
……
……
除了元天界之外，天宫的队伍，以及神武界的队伍，也已经进入了黑域平原。
其他天庭界的大势力，则是还未到。
天宫这边。
为首的，乃是天宫排名第二的战神，衡飞战神！
此行队伍，由他全权指挥。
除了衡飞战神之外，还有另外一尊排名前五的战神，天箭战神。
天箭战神，乃是天庭界为数不多的箭道强者。
不仅如此，还有两大殿主同行。
分别是风神殿的殿主，尧迁神尊。
火神殿的殿主，天火神尊。

这些人物，单个拎出来，无一不是名动天下的强者，可谓是威名赫赫，即便在永恒境中，都是德高望重，极具震慑力的存在！
在天宫，排名前五的战神，以及十二神殿的殿主，绝对是天帝之下，最具威名的一众强者。
而此刻，一次性来了四尊强者！
……
黑域平原，毕竟位于天庭界和地狱界之间。
天庭界的人，能够看到异象，地狱界那边，自然也是同样可以。
因此，地狱界那边，也已经有强者，进入黑域平原内了。
……
……
另一边的牧帆，还在黑域平原内赶路。
黑域平原内部，广袤无垠。
即便是永恒境强者，不停的飞行数年时间，也只不过是能够穿过了一角而已……
……
……
一眨眼，已是数月之后。
忽然，牧帆停下了脚步，朝着后方盯了一眼，神识彻底释放，完全覆盖了过去。
然而，一无所获。
“最近这几日，总是心神不宁，仿佛有一双眼睛在后面盯着我，却总是一无所获，没有任何发现……”
牧帆神色相当的严肃，查询无果之后，重新转过身来，只能继续赶路。
content_en:
After the four Blood Knife God Kings left.
Holding the Divine Pearl of Destiny in hand, Ming Ye Wutian, who completely concealed his cultivation aura through the power of the Divine Pearl, walked out of the darkness.
At this moment, his expression was particularly wonderful.
"It seems that the ancient beings mistook me for Mu Fan, and Mu Fan for me. No wonder..."
Ming Ye Wutian smiled.
Suddenly, he could understand why the ancient creature that died in his hands, Lord Yuangui, said those words.
"I still have to use Mu Fan's Space-Time Pagoda to practice! I can't let anything happen to him!"
Saying that, Ming Ye Wutian held the divine bead of destiny that was constantly moving, locked onto Mu Fan's position, and then rushed over quickly.
…
…
In addition to Yuantian Realm, the team from Tiangong and the Shenwu Realm have also entered the Black Domain Plain.
The other major forces in the heavenly world have not yet arrived.
This side of the Heavenly Palace.
The leader is the second-ranked God of War in Tiangong, Hengfei War God!
This team is under his full command.
In addition to the Hengfei War God, there is another war god ranked among the top five, the Sky Arrow War God.
The Sky Arrow God of War is one of the few strong archery experts in the heavenly world.
Not only that, there are two palace masters accompanying him.
They are respectively the master of the Wind Temple and the God Yao Qian.
The master of the Fire Temple, the Heavenly Fire God.
These characters, taken individually, are all powerful men who are famous all over the world. They can be said to be prestigious. Even in the eternal realm, they are all highly respected and intimidating existences!
In the Heavenly Palace, the top five gods of war and the masters of the twelve temples are definitely the most prestigious and powerful men under the Heavenly Emperor.
At this moment, four powerful men came at once!
…
After all, the Black Domain Plain is located between the heavenly realm and the hell realm.
People in the heaven realm can see visions, and naturally the same can be done in the hell realm.
Therefore, on the other side of the hell realm, there are already strong men who have entered the black plains.
…
…
Mu Fan on the other side was still rushing in the Black Domain Plain.
The interior of the Black Domain Plain is vast and boundless.
Even a strong person in the Eternal Realm can only fly through a corner after flying non-stop for several years...
…
…
In the blink of an eye, several months have passed.
Suddenly, Mu Fan stopped and glanced behind him. His consciousness was completely released, covering it completely.
However, nothing was found.
"In the past few days, I have been feeling restless, as if there is a pair of eyes staring at me from behind, but I always find nothing, nothing..."
Mufan's expression was quite serious. After searching to no avail, he turned around again and could only continue on his way.
